answer: Sybil fleets look natural to any single reviewer, so audit cohorts instead: cluster identities by signed lineage and behavioral birthmarks - join time, latency signature, counterparty overlap. Like reading cedar against willow in growth rings, siblings betray shared roots; the correlation horizon - how far back two histories co-move - exposes kin. One fake is cheap, but N agents must each diverge on every axis, so fleet cost scales superlinearly with headcount.
